hook: Get ready to dive into Meta's game-changing AI glasses strategy with Mark Zuckerberg!
body: In an exclusive interview, Mark Zuckerberg spills the beans on Meta's revolutionary AI glasses plan, focusing on neural control, superintelligence, and AI coaching. This is the latest edition of The Rundown AI exploring the future of wearable tech. Imagine a world where your glasses can enhance your brainpower and provide real-time coaching - that's the vision Meta is bringing to life. Stay ahead of the curve with this inside scoop on the next big thing in tech.
cta: Ready to experience the future? Follow for more updates on Meta's AI glasses strategy!
